name: xonboard
description: Employee onboarding status for Xonboard, built on SuperAPI's embedded superannuation-onboarding platform — employer, employee, and onboarding-session data, via the myHub-hosted Xonboard MCP gateway.

connection.instructions:
Xonboard is an employee-onboarding product built on **SuperAPI** (superapi.com.au), an embedded Australian superannuation-onboarding platform — Xonboard is one of SuperAPI's documented customer products, not a separately-run API.

1. Your SuperAPI **product key** is issued directly by SuperAPI's team (there is no public self-serve signup) — contact support@superapi.com.au, or go through your existing SuperAPI partner contact, and ask for a Xonboard product key.
2. SuperAPI sets sandbox vs production per-partner on the same API host — there is no separate sandbox URL, so make sure you ask for the right one for your use.
3. Paste the product key below. It is sent as the `x-api-key` header on every call; you never paste a bearer token or client secret.

fields.name: XONBOARD_API_KEY
fields.label: SuperAPI Product Key
fields.helpText: Must be a SuperAPI *product* key (prefix `superapiproduct_`), not a partner key. SuperAPI issues these directly — contact support@superapi.com.au or your SuperAPI partner contact; there is no public self-serve signup.
